```{r}
library(tidyverse)

headphones <- read_csv("headphones.csv")

nrow(headphones)
head(headphones)
summary(headphones$decibels)
```
```{r}
# Adding useful time variables:
headphones <- headphones |>
  mutate(
    date        = as_date(startDate),
    year        = year(startDate),
    month       = month(startDate, label = TRUE),
    day_of_week = wday(startDate, label = TRUE),
    hour        = hour(startDate),
    loud        = decibels > 80
  )
```

```{r}
# Has my listening volume changed over the years? 
ggplot(headphones, aes(x = factor(year), y = decibels)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Headphone volume (dB)")
```

```{r}
#Do I listen louder at certain times of day?
headphones |>
  group_by(hour) |>
  summarize(avg_db = mean(decibels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = avg_db)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Hour of day", y = "Average volume (dB)")
```
```{r}
headphones |>
  group_by(hour) |>
  summarize(avg_db = mean(decibels), n = n()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = avg_db)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "hotpink") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 23),
                     labels = c("12am", "6am", "12pm", "6pm", "11pm")) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = c(5.5, 11.5, 16.5, 20.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70") +
  theme_classic() +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "My Headphone Volume by Hour of Day",
       subtitle = "I listen most often late at night and in the early morning, but that's also when my volume is lowest",
       x = "Hour of day",
       y = "Average volume (dB)",
       size = "Number of\nrecordings",
       caption = "Source: Anna's Apple Health data, 2016–2026")
```

```{r}
# Which days of the week am I loudest?
ggplot(headphones, aes(x = day_of_week, y = decibels)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Day of week", y = "Headphone volume (dB)")
```
